parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number to display in the response. Minimum value: 1.

parameters.name: Fuzzy
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use fuzzy query. Valid values:

- **true**: Uses fuzzy query. You must specify the **GroupName** parameter.
- **false**: Queries all consumer groups of the user.

Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The consumer group name to query when fuzzy query is used. Specify this parameter when **Fuzzy** is set to **true**.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of consumer groups to display per page in the response. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 1000.
